skills.name: logo-concept-generation
skills.description: Create logo directions with explicit lettering structure, then generate or critique concepts at the stage you request.
requirements: Web and visual-reference access for research
Image generation and inspection for requested concepts
skills.example_prompt: Use $logo-concept-generation to propose three monochrome wordmark directions for Northline, a fictional outdoor journal. Prompts only.

skills.name: brand-font-exploration
skills.description: Research brand typography, check the relevant font license and compare a shortlist on the actual brand name.
requirements: Web access to foundry or distributor sources
Font Book on macOS and Figma Desktop for the optional installation route
skills.example_prompt: Use $brand-font-exploration to research serif fonts for Northline. Commercial desktop use matters. Give me a shortlist without installing anything.

skills.name: live-word-text-update
skills.description: Edit text in a shared Microsoft Word document while preserving its file identity, revision history and embedded content.
requirements: Access to the exact Word source and shared destination
Bounded editing tools and the ability to reopen the canonical cloud item
skills.example_prompt: Use $live-word-text-update to apply this revised eligibility paragraph to the specified shared Word document. Preserve its title, revision history and adjacent diagram.

skills.name: freeze-pd
skills.description: Export the latest saved Product Document from Word to a dated PDF, inspect it and attach it to Jira only when requested.
requirements: Microsoft Word PDF export and source-document access
Authorized Jira upload and retrieval only for an attachment request
skills.example_prompt: Use $freeze-pd to export the specified Product Document revision as a dated PDF. Keep it local.
